key_decisions.decision: Retain the identification formula and the full territorial span and province count without silently replacing the royal name with Xerxes.
Render the sumptuous materials concretely, with a note qualifying the uncertain names of the paving materials.
Keep the explicit absence of compulsion in this particular rule, without extending it to the court's other practices.
Preserve the command and its objectifying purpose; do not add the unsupported claim that she was to appear naked.
Keep the experts' description open rather than narrowing it to astrology or modern legal practice.
Keep the sweeping accusation explicitly in Memucan's voice rather than making it the narrator's judgment.
Keep the proposed legal permanence, exclusion, and comparative judgment within the advisor's recommendation.
Retain both script and language and the difficult final domestic-language clause; qualify its relation to the decree in a note.
